description: Validation checks to be enforced by future ingestion and pipeline processing scripts.

rules.name: Registered Source Domain Check
rules.description: Source domain must match an entry in config/trusted_sources.json.

rules.name: Source URL Presence Check
rules.description: Source URL field must be present, non-empty, and a valid URI format.

rules.name: Retrieval Timestamp Check
rules.description: Retrieval date must be present as a valid ISO 8601 date-time timestamp.

rules.name: Content Hash Check
rules.description: Cryptographic content hash (SHA-256) must be generated from original raw file bytes.

rules.name: Raw File Storage Verification
rules.description: Original raw document file must exist unmodified in data/raw/.

rules.name: Non-Empty Extracted Text Check
rules.description: Extracted text content from the document must not be empty or zero-length.

rules.name: Metadata Field Completeness Check
rules.description: All required fields defined in document_metadata_schema.json must be present.

rules.name: Duplicate Content Detection
rules.description: Detect duplicate documents using content_hash against existing knowledge base records.

rules.name: Unregistered Source Enforcement
rules.description: Documents from unregistered sources must be rejected or placed in quarantine for review if allow_unregistered_sources is false.

rules.name: Missing or Uncertain Metadata Quarantine
rules.description: Documents with missing, ambiguous, or unverified metadata must be flagged for manual review.
